channel.title: Wire — Engineering
channel.description: Engineering from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Presentation: Understanding Progressive Collapse: How To Avoid A Cascading Failure
item.description: Sam Newman discusses the concept of progressive collapse in civil engineering and how it applies to distributed systems. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Modern Enterprise Architecture: Architecting for Outcomes • Simon Rohrer
BGP Role model: tracking the adoption of RFC 9234
item.description: RFC 9234 lets routers reject route leaks on their own, using BGP Roles and the Only to Customer attribute. We measured who has deployed it, and found two Tier 1 networks unexpectedly stripping OTC. (1 source: cloudflare)

item.title: React Router v8: A Deliberately Boring Release with ESM-Only Builds and Default Middleware
item.description: React Router v8 was released on June 17, 2026, with minimal breaking changes and new baselines. Key updates include an ESM-only build and default middleware settings. React Router v6 and Remix v2 have reached End of Life. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Presentation: From Fab To Token - The State Of The Market
item.description: Jordan Nanos discusses how semiconductor constraints, data center expansion, and networking bottlenecks impact AI software architecture. (1 source: infoq)
